subject: Operational resilience evidence: RTO/RPO custody and warm-start traces
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ops-security@atlaspay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Summers <contract-manager@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Operational resilience evidence: RTO/RPO custody and logs

Hi Jordan,

As part of AtlasPay's SOC 2 SIG review, our security team needs artifacts that demonstrate your operational resilience for the services in scope. Specifically we're asking for:

- The current RTO/RPO runbook(s) used for warm-start and failover scenarios (redacted for private IPs as needed).
- Timestamped KV cache snapshot records for the most recent warm-start test (checksums preferred) and a short descriptor of how snapshots are collected.
- Warm-start trace logs (token-level or op-level timing windows) showing cold->warm->ready timing samples from the last exercise.
- Chain-of-custody / manifest (who triggered the snapshot, S3 object keys, hashes).
- Proposed window to provide a live witness (we'd like a short walkthrough + Q&A).

Can you confirm availability to deliver these artifacts by end of day Tuesday (2027-05-18)? If any items require an NDA or redaction guidance from our side let me know.

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Director, Ops Security
AtlasPay

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ops-security@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operational resilience evidence: RTO/RPO custody and logs

Hi Ari — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the materials you requested. High-level plan below and attachments in the follow-up message: 

1) Runbook: attached as rto_runbook_v2.pdf. The document includes step-by-step warm-start actions, team roles, and fallbacks; we removed internal hostnames and private IPs.

2) KV snapshots: we will provide a checksum CSV (kv_snapshot_checksums_20270514.csv) that lists the S3 key, UTC timestamp, checksum (SHA256) and the initiating operator id. Sensitive keys are redacted; the manifest will map the redacted ids to operator-roles only.

3) Warm-start traces: warmstart-traces-20270514.zip contains the aggregated trace windows (start, readied, accepting-traffic) and per-shard timings. We will include an easily parsed summary table (median, p50/p95).

4) Chain-of-custody: we'll include kv_lineage_manifest_20270517.csv with action stamps and the audit job id.

5) Live witness: we can host a 30-minute session on Thursday 2027-05-20 between 10:00–11:30 PT. Please confirm which 30-min slot works.

Important notes: the attached CSVs and traces are sanitized to remove IPs and full UUIDs — we preserve the ability to validate checksums and timeline integrity. If you need PGP signatures on the artifacts, we can provide them (we use internal key id 0xAB12CDEF).

I'll push the artifacts in a follow-up email with a Drive link and checksums.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: rto_runbook_v2.pdf, kv_snapshot_checksums_20270514.csv, warmstart-traces-20270514.zip

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Operational resilience evidence: internal pack checklist

Jordan — quick internal checklist before you send the package to AtlasPay: 

- Ensure all S3 keys in the CSV are truncated to the object id suffix (we keep the prefix internal).
- Add a short "How to verify" block in the CSV header: "Run SHA256 against S3 object and compare to checksum column."
- Include the manifest column "initiated_by_role" not a username.
- Add a one-paragraph mapping doc for SIG controls: map runbook section -> SIG question. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/soc2/mapping/rto-to-sig
- Add the kv_lineage_manifest_20270517.csv with operator stamps and job-id.

Suggested external blurb (paste into your reply):

"We have sanitized the artifacts to remove private network identifiers while preserving verifiable checksums and timeline integrity. Attached are the runbook and a manifest that maps snapshot objects to audit job IDs. If you want us to sign artifacts with our PGP key, we can provide the detached signatures."

Once you send, I'll update the HubSpot ticket HS-1182745 and note the witness slot.

Kimberly
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ops-security@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Leah Summers <contract-manager@atlaspay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Operational resilience evidence package and witness options

Ari / Leah — attaching the sanitized package per your request. Items attached and links below: 

Attachments included (sanitized):
- rto_runbook_v2.pdf (redacted internal hostnames)
- kv_snapshot_checksums_20270514.csv (columns: s3_key_suffix, utc_timestamp, sha256_checksum, initiated_by_role)
- kv_lineage_manifest_20270517.csv (operator role stamps, audit job id: audit-20270514-77)
- warmstart-traces-20270514.zip (aggregated timing traces + summary.csv)

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AtlasPay/RTO-evidence-20270517
HubSpot record: HS-1182745

How to verify: download S3 object, compute SHA256, compare to checksum column. For immediate verification we can provide a short demo of the checksum verification steps during the witness call.

Proposed witness windows (30-minute live walk-through + 15 minutes Q&A):
- Thu 2027-05-20 10:00–10:30 PT (preferred)
- Thu 2027-05-20 11:00–11:30 PT

If you'd like the artifacts PGP-signed, reply and we'll deliver detached signatures.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rto_runbook_v2.pdf; kv_snapshot_checksums_20270514.csv; kv_lineage_manifest_20270517.csv; warmstart-traces-20270514.zip

Jordan — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear verification steps. We received the Drive package and the attachments look complete. Thu 2027-05-20 10:00 PT works for our team for the live witness. Please include a 5–10 minute demo of the checksum verification and a short explanation of how the manifest links to the audit job id.

If you can PGP-sign the manifests before the session that would be ideal, otherwise a signed copy after the call is fine.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Ari Kaplan

AtlasPay
